On the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], a hidden '''fortress''' was constructed by [[Belia Darzu]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who lived during the [[New Sith Wars]]. A square-shaped structure made from [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], the stronghold contained several [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratories]] where Darzu experimented with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. As a military facility, the fortress featured numerous barracks that housed an [[Metanecrons|army]] of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] creatures called [[technobeast]]s. Beneath the stronghold was a large underground chamber containing the [[Holocron of Belia Darzu|personal holocron]] of Belia Darzu. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Darzu, the fortress remained intact for over two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] in the absence of its creator.

==Description==
{{Quote|I feared the defenses of Belia's stronghold would be impenetrable.|Hetton|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
[[File:Tython-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Tython, the planet upon which the fortress was constructed.]]

Constructed on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the fortress of [[Belia Darzu]] was a square-shaped building measuring 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] on each side. Made from [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and used primarily as a military base, the stronghold was surrounded by a thirty-meter high wall. At the front of the fortress were two towers erected ten meters up from the corners of the exterior wall. Each of these towers harbored an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] operated by an [[automated defense system]]. Located on the front exterior wall was the fortress's entrance, consisting of a twenty-meter wide gate with no visible handles, hinges, nor a control panel.<ref name="DBROT" />

The entrance of the fortress led into a long hallway, providing access to the rest of the installation. As a military base, the stronghold's interior mainly consisted of numerous barracks and mess halls. Further into the structure, however, were a number of [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratories]] containing a range of equipment and apparatus for Belia Darzu's [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] experiments. Inside some of these labs were sealed beakers resting on top of long metal tables, as well as glass piping lined along the walls. Some rooms contained specimen bottles holding the [[Brain/Legends|brains]] and [[Heart/Legends|hearts]] from a dozen different [[Species/Legends|species]], while other labs held notes and sketches following Darzu's research.<ref name="DBROT" />

Towards the back of the structure—beyond the laboratories—was a narrow stairway leading into a separate underground level of the fortress. Within this lower level, a long hallway led towards the inner sanctum of Belia Darzu, accessible through a small wooden door. The inner sanctum consisted of a chamber that was around fifty meters long and twenty meters wide, featuring a pedestal in the center of the room holding the [[holocron of Belia Darzu]].<ref name="DBROT" />

==History==
===Sictis Wars===
{{Quote|Do you know the name of Belia Darzu? She was a Dark Lord of the Sith who reigned over two centuries ago.|Hetton|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
[[File:BeliaDarzuCropped.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Belia Darzu constructed and used the stronghold to house her alchemical creations.]]

At some point before the end of [[1230 BBY]],<ref name="Fortress date" /> the fortress was constructed by Belia Darzu,<ref name="CSWE-MYSTIC" /> a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who rose to power in [[1250 BBY]] during the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="DBROT" /><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Choosing the Deep Core world of Tython for the location of the stronghold, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Darzu drew upon the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] that had since become infused into the planet.<ref name="CSWE-TYTHON">{{CSWECite|III|273|Tython}}</ref> Within her fortress,<ref name="DBROT" /> the Dark Lord researched the art of Sith alchemy and a [[Force power/Legends|Force technique]] called ''[[mechu-deru]]'', using her knowledge to create [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] creatures known as [[technobeast]]s.<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Details regarding Sith alchemy, ''mechu-deru'' and various other topics were recorded in Darzu's personal [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], a device that was stored in the underground inner sanctum of the fortress.<ref name="DBROT" /> The stronghold served as a barracks, housing the Dark Lord's technobeast [[Army/Legends|army]]<ref name="DBROT" />—the [[Metanecrons]]<ref name="END" />—that was unleashed against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Sictis Wars]].<ref name="DBROT" /><ref name="TEA" /> This campaign ended in 1230 BBY when Darzu was [[Assassination of Belia Darzu|assassinated]] on Tython by the [[Mecrosa Order]],<ref name="NEGD" /><ref name="DBROT" /> though the fortress nonetheless remained intact and operational for over two centuries after her death.<ref name="DBROT" />

===Abandonment===
{{Quote|When she fell all her secrets were lost, though there is speculation that much of what she discovered is still stored in the archives of her stronghold on Tython.|Hetton, regarding Belia Darzu|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
In the aftermath of Darzu's fall, the remaining technobeasts continued to inhabit the stronghold and wander its halls. The fortress was otherwise devoid of any lifeforms, lacking even insects or other types of vermin. The holocron of Belia Darzu radiated with dark side energy, causing its power to flow throughout the entire fortress. Attracted by this power, all of the surviving technobeasts made their way towards Belia's inner sanctum, congregating around the holocron.<ref name="DBROT" />

By [[990 BBY]], the location of Darzu's fortress had been uncovered by [[Hetton]], a [[Noble/Legends|nobleman]] and a collector of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]]. This information was eventually divulged to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], a survivor of the New Sith Wars who [[Mission to Tython|infiltrated]] Darzu's fortress with hopes of finding her holocron. In his attempt to seize the device, Bane was attacked by the remaining technobeasts that lingered within the inner sanctum, forcing him to destroy the creatures. Shortly after Bane retrieved the holocron, he and his apprentice, [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], barricaded themselves inside the fortress as they were pursued by a group of five [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]—[[Valenthyne Farfalla]], [[Johun Othone]], [[Raskta Lsu]], [[Sarro Xaj]], and [[Worror Dowmat]]. A [[Duel on Tython|lightsaber duel]] ensued between the group, during which Bane and Zannah managed to kill all five of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]].<ref name="DBROT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fortress of Belia Darzu first appeared in the novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', the second volume of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']].<ref name="DBROT" /> In ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an illustration by artist [[Chris Scalf]] depicted the fortress's interior.<ref name="WAR">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
